name: dockerdiscordcontrol
description:
Control your Docker containers directly from Discord![br][br]
Interactive Discord bot with buttons to start, stop, restart, and monitor containers. Includes a web dashboard for configuration, task scheduling, auto-actions, and channel translation (DeepL/Google/Microsoft). Available in 40 languages.[br][br]
Alpine-based image, less than 200 MB RAM.[br][br]
[b]Setup:[/b] Access the Web UI at http://[YOUR-IP]:9374 and log in with username "admin", password "setup".[br]
Homepage: https://ddc.bot
requires: Docker socket access for container management. Create a Discord bot token before first use.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions. Unraid default: 100 (users).

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for web UI admin user (username: admin). If not set, use username "admin", password "setup" for first login.

variables.name: Flask Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key for session security. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. If not set, sessions reset on restart.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Discord bot token. Can also be configured via the Web UI after first login.

author: selfhosters
